#### FILE: scripts/android-setup.sh ####
#!/bin/bash
set -e
DEST=android/app/src/main/java/app/fraxinetum
mkdir -p "$DEST" android/app/src/main/java/android/print
cp native/PrintHtmlPlugin.java "$DEST/PrintHtmlPlugin.java"
cp native/MainActivity.java "$DEST/MainActivity.java"
cp native/PdfWriter.java android/app/src/main/java/android/print/PdfWriter.java

# allow plain-http sites to be archived
sed -i 's/<application/<application android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"/' android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml

# fixed signing key: every build is signed the same way, so a new APK installs
# OVER the old one (data kept). Gradle's debug build reads this exact file.
mkdir -p ~/.android
base64 -d assets/debug.keystore.b64 > ~/.android/debug.keystore

# build number = GitHub run number (must grow for Android to accept an update)
N="${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER:-1}"
sed -i "s/versionCode [0-9]*/versionCode $N/; s/versionName \"[^\"]*\"/versionName \"1.$N\"/" android/app/build.gradle
grep -n "versionCode\|versionName" android/app/build.gradle

# app icon from the app picture
pip install --quiet --break-system-packages pillow 2>/dev/null || pip install --quiet pillow || true
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
im = Image.open("src/assets/logo.jpg").convert("RGB")
sizes = {"mdpi": 48, "hdpi": 72, "xhdpi": 96, "xxhdpi": 144, "xxxhdpi": 192}
for d, s in sizes.items():
    base = "android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-" + d
    sq = im.resize((s, s), Image.LANCZOS)
    sq.save(base + "/ic_launcher.png")
    mask = Image.new("L", (s * 4, s * 4), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).ellipse((0, 0, s * 4 - 1, s * 4 - 1), fill=255)
    mask = mask.resize((s, s), Image.LANCZOS)
    rd = Image.new("RGBA", (s, s), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    rd.paste(sq, (0, 0), mask)
    rd.save(base + "/ic_launcher_round.png")
print("icons written")
PY
# use the plain PNG icons on every Android version (drop the adaptive-icon xml)
rm -rf android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26

#### FILE: native/PrintHtmlPlugin.java ####
package app.fraxinetum;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.print.PdfWriter;
import android.print.PrintDocumentAdapter;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.webkit.WebView;
import android.webkit.WebViewClient;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "PrintHtml")
public class PrintHtmlPlugin extends Plugin {
    private WebView pdfView;

    /* HTML -> PDF file directly (no print dialog). On Android 10+ the file is
       saved to Download/FRAXINETUM; on older versions the cache path is
       returned so the app can open the share sheet. */
    @PluginMethod
    public void toPdf(final PluginCall call) {
        final String html = call.getString("html", "");
        final String filename = call.getString("filename", "FRAXINETUM.pdf");
        getActivity().runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                pdfView = new WebView(getActivity());
                pdfView.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient() {
                    private boolean started = false;

                    @Override
                    public void onPageFinished(final WebView view, String url) {
                        if (started) return;
                        started = true;
                        // small delay so remote images finish drawing
                        new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(new Runnable() {
                            @Override
                            public void run() {
                                final File out = new File(getContext().getCacheDir(), filename);
                                PrintDocumentAdapter adapter = view.createPrintDocumentAdapter("FRAXINETUM");
                                PdfWriter.write(adapter, out, new PdfWriter.Done() {
                                    @Override
                                    public void onDone(boolean ok, String error) {
                                        if (!ok) {
                                            call.reject("PDF failed: " + error);
                                            return;
                                        }
                                        JSObject res = new JSObject();
                                        res.put("path", out.getAbsolutePath());
                                        try {
                                            String where = saveToDownloads(out, filename);
                                            res.put("saved", where != null);
                                            res.put("location", where == null ? "" : where);
                                        } catch (Exception e) {
                                            res.put("saved", false);
                                            res.put("location", "");
                                        }
                                        call.resolve(res);
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                        }, 700);
                    }
                });
                pdfView.loadDataWithBaseURL("https://localhost/", html, "text/html", "UTF-8", null);
            }
        });
    }

    private String saveToDownloads(File f, String name) throws Exception {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 29) return null;
        ContentResolver resolver = getContext().getContentResolver();
        ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
        v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, name);
        v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, "application/pdf");
        v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, "Download/FRAXINETUM");
        Uri uri = resolver.insert(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, v);
        if (uri == null) return null;
        try (OutputStream os = resolver.openOutputStream(uri); InputStream is = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int n;
            while ((n = is.read(buf)) > 0) os.write(buf, 0, n);
        }
        return "Download/FRAXINETUM/" + name;
    }
}

#### FILE: native/PdfWriter.java ####
package android.print;

import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import java.io.File;

/* Lives in package android.print on purpose: the layout/write callbacks have
   package-private constructors. Writes a WebView print adapter straight to a PDF
   file — no print dialog, no preview. */
public class PdfWriter {
    public interface Done {
        void onDone(boolean ok, String error);
    }

    public static void write(final PrintDocumentAdapter adapter, final File file, final Done done) {
        PrintAttributes attrs = new PrintAttributes.Builder()
                .setMediaSize(PrintAttributes.MediaSize.ISO_A4)
                .setResolution(new PrintAttributes.Resolution("pdf", "pdf", 300, 300))
                .setMinMargins(PrintAttributes.Margins.NO_MARGINS)
                .build();
        adapter.onLayout(null, attrs, new CancellationSignal(), new PrintDocumentAdapter.LayoutResultCallback() {
            @Override
            public void onLayoutFinished(PrintDocumentInfo info, boolean changed) {
                try {
                    final ParcelFileDescriptor fd = ParcelFileDescriptor.open(file,
                            ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_WRITE
                                    | ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_CREATE
                                    | ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_TRUNCATE);
                    adapter.onWrite(new PageRange[]{PageRange.ALL_PAGES}, fd, new CancellationSignal(),
                            new PrintDocumentAdapter.WriteResultCallback() {
                                @Override
                                public void onWriteFinished(PageRange[] pages) {
                                    try { fd.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                                    done.onDone(true, null);
                                }

                                @Override
                                public void onWriteFailed(CharSequence error) {
                                    try { fd.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                                    done.onDone(false, String.valueOf(error));
                                }
                            });
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    done.onDone(false, String.valueOf(e));
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onLayoutFailed(CharSequence error) {
                done.onDone(false, String.valueOf(error));
            }
        }, null);
    }
}

#### FILE: src/format.js ####
export function faNum(n) {
  return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString("fa-IR");
}

export function formatFaDate(value) {
  if (!value || !String(value).trim()) return "";
  const raw = String(value).trim();
  const d = new Date(raw.length <= 10 ? raw + "T00:00:00" : raw);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return raw.slice(0, 10);
  try {
    return d.toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
  } catch (e) {
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

export function faLongDate(ts) {
  const d = ts ? new Date(ts) : new Date();
  try {
    return d.toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
  } catch (e) {
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

#### FILE: src/net.js ####
/* Native HTTP on Android (CapacitorHttp): no CORS limits, any site can be fetched. */
import { Capacitor, CapacitorHttp } from "@capacitor/core";
import { decodeBytes } from "./site.js";

const UA = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Mobile Safari/537.36 FRAXINETUM/1.0";

function b64ToBytes(b64) {
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}

function headerOf(h, name) {
  if (!h) return "";
  for (const k of Object.keys(h)) if (k.toLowerCase() === name) return String(h[k]);
  return "";
}

export async function fetchRaw(url, timeoutMs = 25000, accept = "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8") {
  if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
    const r = await CapacitorHttp.get({
      url,
      headers: { "User-Agent": UA, Accept: accept, "Accept-Language": "fa,en;q=0.9" },
      responseType: "arraybuffer",
      connectTimeout: timeoutMs,
      readTimeout: timeoutMs,
    });
    return {
      status: r.status,
      bytes: typeof r.data === "string" ? b64ToBytes(r.data) : new Uint8Array(0),
      contentType: headerOf(r.headers, "content-type"),
      url: r.url || url,
    };
  }
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctl.signal, headers: { Accept: accept } });
    return {
      status: res.status,
      bytes: new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer()),
      contentType: res.headers.get("content-type") || "",
      url: res.url || url,
    };
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

export async function fetchHtml(url, timeoutMs) {
  const r = await fetchRaw(url, timeoutMs);
  if (r.status >= 400) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
  if (r.contentType && !/text\/html|application\/xhtml|text\/plain|application\/xml|text\/xml/i.test(r.contentType)) {
    throw new Error("not-html");
  }
  return { html: decodeBytes(r.bytes, r.contentType), finalUrl: r.url };
}

export async function fetchText(url, timeoutMs = 15000) {
  try {
    const r = await fetchRaw(url, timeoutMs, "application/xml,text/xml,text/plain,*/*");
    if (r.status >= 400) return "";
    return decodeBytes(r.bytes, r.contentType);
  } catch (_e) {
    return "";
  }
}

#### FILE: src/site.js ####
/* URL helpers, sitemap reading and link extraction (ported from the Base44 version). */
import { fetchText } from "./net.js";

const FILE_EXT = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|svg|bmp|ico|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|atom|pdf|zip|rar|gz|7z|tar|mp3|mp4|m4a|webm|avi|mov|wmv|woff2?|ttf|eot|otf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|exe|dmg|apk)$/i;
const SKIP_PATH = /(\/wp-admin|\/wp-login|\/wp-json|\/xmlrpc|\/feed|\/rss|\/login|\/signin|\/signup|\/register|\/logout|\/cart|\/checkout|\/account|\/my-account|\/search|\/tag\/|\/tags\/|\/author\/|\/page\/\d+|\/cdn-cgi\/)/i;
const TRACKING = /^(utm_|fbclid|gclid|mc_|_ga|replytocom)/i;

export function normalizeUrl(href, base) {
  if (!href) return null;
  const h = String(href).trim();
  if (!h || h.startsWith("#")) return null;
  if (/^(javascript|mailto|tel|data|blob|whatsapp|sms|ftp|file):/i.test(h)) return null;
  try {
    const u = new URL(h, base);
    if (u.protocol !== "http:" && u.protocol !== "https:") return null;
    u.hash = "";
    const drop = [];
    u.searchParams.forEach((_v, k) => { if (TRACKING.test(k)) drop.push(k); });
    drop.forEach((k) => u.searchParams.delete(k));
    let s = u.toString();
    if (u.pathname !== "/" && s.endsWith("/") && !u.search) s = s.slice(0, -1);
    return s;
  } catch (_e) {
    return null;
  }
}

export function firstTextOf(...values) {
  for (const v of values) if (v && String(v).trim()) return String(v).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return "";
}

export function bareHost(url) {
  try { return new URL(url).host.replace(/^www\./i, "").toLowerCase(); } catch (_e) { return ""; }
}

export function pathOf(url) {
  try { return decodeURIComponent(new URL(url).pathname); } catch (_e) { return url; }
}

export function sectionOf(url) {
  const parts = pathOf(url).split("/").filter(Boolean);
  return parts.length ? parts[0] : "";
}

/* same host, not a file, not a login/search/tag style page */
export function isCrawlable(url, host) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (host && bareHost(url) !== host) return false;
    if (FILE_EXT.test(u.pathname)) return false;
    if (SKIP_PATH.test(u.pathname)) return false;
    return true;
  } catch (_e) {
    return false;
  }
}

export function decodeBytes(bytes, contentType) {
  let charset = "";
  const m = /charset=["']?([\w-]+)/i.exec(contentType || "");
  if (m) charset = m[1];
  if (!charset) {
    const head = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: false }).decode(bytes.slice(0, 5000));
    const mm = /charset=["']?([\w-]+)/i.exec(head);
    if (mm) charset = mm[1];
  }
  let norm = (charset || "utf-8").toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^cp1256$/, "windows-1256");
  if (!norm) norm = "utf-8";
  try { return new TextDecoder(norm, { fatal: false }).decode(bytes); }
  catch (_e) { return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: false }).decode(bytes); }
}

export function readSiteName(html) {
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
  const og = root.querySelector('meta[property="og:site_name"]');
  const t = root.querySelector("title");
  return String((og && og.getAttribute("content")) || (t && t.textContent) || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 160);
}

export function parseSitemapXml(xml) {
  const urls = [];
  const children = [];
  const re = /<(url|sitemap)[\s>][\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi;
  const locRe = /<loc>\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*<\/loc>/i;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(xml))) {
    const loc = locRe.exec(m[0]);
    if (!loc) continue;
    const value = loc[1].trim().replace(/&amp;/g, "&").replace(/^<!\[CDATA\[|\]\]>$/g, "");
    if (!value) continue;
    if (m[1].toLowerCase() === "sitemap") children.push(value);
    else urls.push(value);
  }
  return { urls, children };
}

export async function collectSitemapUrls(rootUrl, limit) {
  const origin = new URL(rootUrl).origin;
  const queue = [];
  const seenSm = new Set();
  const found = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  let sitemapUrl = "";

  const robots = await fetchText(origin + "/robots.txt", 12000);
  robots.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line) => {
    const mm = /^\s*sitemap\s*:\s*(\S+)/i.exec(line);
    if (mm) queue.push(mm[1].trim());
  });
  if (!queue.length) {
    queue.push(origin + "/sitemap.xml", origin + "/sitemap_index.xml", origin + "/sitemap-index.xml", origin + "/sitemap1.xml");
  }

  let visited = 0;
  while (queue.length && visited < 400 && found.length < limit) {
    const sm = queue.shift();
    if (!sm || seenSm.has(sm)) continue;
    seenSm.add(sm);
    visited += 1;
    const xml = (await fetchText(sm, 20000)).slice(0, 8000000);
    if (!xml) continue;
    const parsed = parseSitemapXml(xml);
    if (parsed.urls.length || parsed.children.length) sitemapUrl = sitemapUrl || sm;
    parsed.children.forEach((c) => queue.push(c));
    for (const u of parsed.urls) {
      if (found.length >= limit) break;
      const n = normalizeUrl(u, sm);
      if (n && !seen.has(n)) { seen.add(n); found.push(n); }
    }
  }
  return { urls: found, sitemapUrl };
}

/* every internal link of the WHOLE page (menus included) */
export function extractLinks(html, baseUrl, host) {
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
  const out = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  root.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach((a) => {
    const abs = normalizeUrl(a.getAttribute("href"), baseUrl);
    if (!abs || seen.has(abs)) return;
    if (!isCrawlable(abs, host)) return;
    seen.add(abs);
    out.push(abs);
  });
  return out;
}

#### FILE: src/extract.js ####
import { normalizeUrl, pathOf, sectionOf, firstTextOf } from "./site.js";

const JUNK_RE = /(^|[-_ ])(sidebar|widget|navbar|menu|comment|comments|sharing|social|advert|advertisement|ads|banner|breadcrumb|breadcrumbs|pagination|pager|popup|modal|newsletter|subscribe|subscription|cookie|related|recommend|recommended|post-tags|tags-list|entry-meta|meta-box|author-box|toolbar|skip-link|rating|rating-box|share)([-_ ]|$)/i;

const DROP_TAGS = new Set([
  "script", "style", "noscript", "template", "svg", "canvas", "form", "button", "input",
  "select", "option", "textarea", "label", "iframe", "video", "audio", "object", "embed",
  "map", "nav", "header", "footer", "aside", "link", "meta", "base", "dialog",
]);

const ALLOWED = new Set([
  "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "p", "ul", "ol", "li", "blockquote", "pre", "code",
  "figure", "figcaption", "table", "thead", "tbody", "tr", "td", "th", "caption",
  "strong", "b", "em", "i", "u", "br", "hr", "sub", "sup", "dl", "dt", "dd", "mark",
]);

const IMG_SKIP_RE = /(logo|icon|sprite|placeholder|blank|spacer|pixel|1x1|favicon|emoji|gravatar|loader|loading)/i;

const MAX_CONTENT = 110000;

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}

function escapeAttr(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}

function tagOf(el) {
  return String((el && (el.rawTagName || el.tagName)) || "").toLowerCase();
}

function attrOf(el, name) {
  return (el && el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute(name)) || "";
}

function isJunk(el) {
  const blob = attrOf(el, "class") + " " + attrOf(el, "id") + " " + attrOf(el, "role");
  return JUNK_RE.test(blob);
}

function textLen(el) {
  if (!el) return 0;
  return (el.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().length;
}

function textOf(el) {
  return el ? String(el.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() : "";
}

function stripJunk(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll("*").forEach((el) => {
    const tag = tagOf(el);
    if (tag === "form" && textLen(el) > 1500) return; // ASP.NET-style sites wrap the whole page in <form>
    if (DROP_TAGS.has(tag)) {
      el.remove();
      return;
    }
    if (isJunk(el) && !/^(html|body|main|article)$/.test(tag)) el.remove();
  });
}

function depthOf(el) {
  let d = 0;
  let cur = el;
  while (cur && cur.parentNode) {
    d += 1;
    cur = cur.parentNode;
    if (d > 40) break;
  }
  return d;
}

function pickContainer(root) {
  const body = root.querySelector("body") || root;
  const candidates = root.querySelectorAll("article, main, div, section, td");
  let best = null;
  let bestScore = -1;
  candidates.forEach((el) => {
    const total = textLen(el);
    if (total < 250) return;
    let linkText = 0;
    el.querySelectorAll("a").forEach((a) => {
      linkText += textLen(a);
    });
    const content = Math.max(0, total - linkText);
    if (content < 200) return;
    const density = content / Math.max(1, total);
    const tag = tagOf(el);
    const bonus = tag === "article" ? 250 : tag === "main" ? 150 : 0;
    const score = content * (0.4 + 0.6 * density) + bonus + depthOf(el) * 4;
    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      best = el;
    }
  });
  return best || body;
}

function jsonLdNodes(root) {
  const nodes = [];
  root.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]').forEach((s) => {
    let txt = s.rawText || s.textContent || "";
    txt = txt.replace(/^\s*<!\[CDATA\[/, "").replace(/\]\]>\s*$/, "").trim();
    if (!txt) return;
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(txt);
      const push = (v) => {
        if (!v) return;
        if (Array.isArray(v)) {
          v.forEach(push);
          return;
        }
        if (typeof v !== "object") return;
        if (v["@graph"]) push(v["@graph"]);
        nodes.push(v);
      };
      push(data);
    } catch (_e) {
      /* malformed json-ld is ignored */
    }
  });
  return nodes;
}

function typeOfNode(node) {
  const t = node && node["@type"];
  return (Array.isArray(t) ? t.join(",") : String(t || "")).toLowerCase();
}

function joinValue(v) {
  if (!v) return "";
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(joinValue).filter(Boolean).join("، ");
  if (typeof v === "object") return firstTextOf(v.name, v["@id"], v.url);
  return String(v);
}

function metaContentOf(root, sel) {
  const el = root.querySelector(sel);
  return el ? attrOf(el, "content") : "";
}

function readMeta(root, url) {
  const nodes = jsonLdNodes(root);
  const article = nodes.find((n) => /article|blogposting|newsarticle|posting|webpage|report/.test(typeOfNode(n))) || nodes[0] || {};
  const h1 = root.querySelector("h1");
  const titleEl = root.querySelector("title");
  const timeEl = root.querySelector("time[datetime]");

  const title = firstTextOf(
    article.headline,
    article.name,
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="og:title"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="twitter:title"]'),
    h1 ? h1.textContent : "",
    titleEl ? titleEl.textContent : "",
  );

  const published = firstTextOf(
    joinValue(article.datePublished),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="article:published_time"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="date"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="pubdate"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[itemprop="datePublished"]'),
    timeEl ? attrOf(timeEl, "datetime") : "",
    timeEl ? timeEl.textContent : "",
  );

  const updated = firstTextOf(
    joinValue(article.dateModified),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="article:modified_time"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="last-modified"]'),
  );

  let author = article.author ? joinValue(article.author) : "";
  author = firstTextOf(
    author,
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="author"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="article:author"]'),
    textOf(root.querySelector('[rel="author"]')),
    textOf(root.querySelector(".author-name")),
  );
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(author)) author = "";

  const description = firstTextOf(
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="description"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="og:description"]'),
    joinValue(article.description),
  );

  let category = joinValue(article.articleSection);
  if (!category) {
    const crumbs = root.querySelectorAll('[class*="breadcrumb" i] a');
    if (crumbs.length) category = textOf(crumbs[crumbs.length - 1]);
  }
  if (!category) category = sectionOf(url);

  const keywords = firstTextOf(metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="keywords"]'), joinValue(article.keywords));
  const tags = keywords
    ? keywords.split(/[,،]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 12)
    : [];

  return { title, published, updated, author, description, category, tags: tags.join("، ") };
}

function imageFrom(el, ctx) {
  const src = attrOf(el, "data-src") || attrOf(el, "data-lazy-src") || attrOf(el, "data-original") || attrOf(el, "src");
  let candidate = src;
  if (!candidate) {
    const srcset = attrOf(el, "data-srcset") || attrOf(el, "srcset");
    if (srcset && !/^data:/i.test(srcset)) candidate = srcset.split(",")[0].trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
  }
  if (!candidate || /^data:/i.test(candidate)) return null;
  const abs = normalizeUrl(candidate, ctx.base);
  if (!abs) return null;
  if (ctx.seenImg.has(abs)) return null;
  if (IMG_SKIP_RE.test(abs)) return null;
  const w = parseInt(attrOf(el, "width") || "0", 10) || 0;
  const h = parseInt(attrOf(el, "height") || "0", 10) || 0;
  if ((w && w < 130) || (h && h < 130)) return null;
  const alt = firstTextOf(attrOf(el, "alt"), attrOf(el, "title"));
  ctx.seenImg.add(abs);
  ctx.images.push({ url: abs, alt });
  return '<img src="' + escapeAttr(abs) + '" alt="' + escapeAttr(alt) + '" />';
}

function walk(node, ctx, out) {
  const children = node.childNodes || [];
  for (const child of children) {
    if (child.nodeType === 3) {
      const t = child.textContent || "";
      if (t.trim()) out.push(escapeHtml(t.replace(/\s+/g, " ")));
      continue;
    }
    if (child.nodeType !== 1) continue;
    const tag = tagOf(child);
    if (!tag) continue;
    if ((DROP_TAGS.has(tag) && !(tag === "form" && textLen(child) > 1500)) || isJunk(child)) continue;

    if (tag === "img") {
      const img = imageFrom(child, ctx);
      if (img) out.push(img);
      continue;
    }

    if (tag === "figure" || tag === "picture") {
      const imgs = child.querySelectorAll("img");
      let any = false;
      imgs.forEach((im) => {
        const rendered = imageFrom(im, ctx);
        if (rendered) {
          out.push(rendered);
          any = true;
        }
      });
      const cap = child.querySelector("figcaption");
      if (cap && any) {
        const t = textOf(cap);
        if (t) out.push("<figcaption>" + escapeHtml(t) + "</figcaption>");
      }
      if (!any) walk(child, ctx, out);
      continue;
    }

    if (tag === "a") {
      const href = normalizeUrl(attrOf(child, "href"), ctx.base);
      const inner = [];
      walk(child, ctx, inner);
      const body = inner.join("").trim();
      if (!body) continue;
      if (href && ctx.links.length < 150 && !ctx.seenLink.has(href) && href !== ctx.base) {
        ctx.seenLink.add(href);
        ctx.links.push(href);
      }
      out.push(href ? '<a href="' + escapeAttr(href) + '">' + body + "</a>" : body);
      continue;
    }

    if (ALLOWED.has(tag)) {
      const inner = [];
      walk(child, ctx, inner);
      const joined = inner.join("").trim();
      if (!joined) continue;
      if (/^(h[1-6]|p|li|blockquote|td|th|figcaption)$/.test(tag)) {
        out.push("<" + tag + ">" + joined + "</" + tag + ">");
      } else {
        out.push("<" + tag + ">" + joined + "</" + tag + ">");
      }
      continue;
    }

    walk(child, ctx, out);
  }
}

function tidy(html) {
  let out = html;
  out = out.replace(/<(p|li|h[1-6]|blockquote|figcaption)>\s*<\/\1>/g, "");
  out = out.replace(/(<br\s*\/?>\s*){2,}/g, "<br/>");
  out = out.replace(/<p>\s*(<br\s*\/?>\s*)+/g, "<p>");
  out = out.replace(/(\s*<br\s*\/?>\s*)+<\/p>/g, "</p>");
  out = out.replace(/<p>\s*&nbsp;\s*<\/p>/g, "");
  out = out.replace(/\s{3,}/g, " ");
  return out.trim();
}

export function plainText(html) {
  return String(html || "")
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

export function extractPage(html, url) {
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
  const meta = readMeta(root, url);
  stripJunk(root);
  const container = pickContainer(root);

  const ctx = { images: [], links: [], seenImg: new Set(), seenLink: new Set(), base: url };
  const out = [];
  walk(container, ctx, out);
  let contentHtml = tidy(out.join(""));

  const titlePlain = plainText(meta.title);
  const leading = /^\s*<h[12][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h[12]>/i.exec(contentHtml);
  if (leading && plainText(leading[1]) === titlePlain) {
    contentHtml = contentHtml.slice(leading[0].length).trim();
  }

  const headings = [];
  container.querySelectorAll("h1, h2, h3, h4").forEach((h) => {
    const t = textOf(h);
    if (t && t.length > 1 && headings.length < 40 && headings[headings.length - 1] !== t) headings.push(t.slice(0, 180));
  });

  let truncated = false;
  if (contentHtml.length > MAX_CONTENT) {
    contentHtml = contentHtml.slice(0, MAX_CONTENT);
    truncated = true;
  }

  const plain = plainText(contentHtml);
  const wordCount = plain ? plain.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length : 0;

  return {
    title: meta.title || pathOf(url),
    author: meta.author || "",
    published_date: meta.published || "",
    updated_date: meta.updated || "",
    category: meta.category || "",
    description: meta.description || "",
    tags: meta.tags || "",
    section: sectionOf(url),
    path: pathOf(url),
    headings,
    images: ctx.images.slice(0, 60),
    image_count: ctx.images.length,
    outbound_links: ctx.links.slice(0, 100),
    content_html: contentHtml,
    text_preview: plain.slice(0, 700),
    word_count: wordCount,
    truncated,
    status: "extracted",
    links_parsed: true,
    error: "",
  };
}

#### FILE: src/store.js ####
/* Everything lives in this phone's IndexedDB: projects, page list, article text. */
const DB_NAME = "fraxinetum";
let dbp = null;

function db() {
  if (dbp) return dbp;
  dbp = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const d = req.result;
      d.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
      const pages = d.createObjectStore("pages", { keyPath: "id" });
      pages.createIndex("project_id", "project_id");
      d.createObjectStore("content");
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
  return dbp;
}

const wait = (tx) =>
  new Promise((res, rej) => {
    tx.oncomplete = () => res();
    tx.onerror = () => rej(tx.error);
    tx.onabort = () => rej(tx.error || new Error("حافظهٔ گوشی پر است یا عملیات لغو شد."));
  });

const asPromise = (req) =>
  new Promise((res, rej) => { req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result); req.onerror = () => rej(req.error); });

export async function requestPersistence() {
  try { if (navigator.storage?.persist) await navigator.storage.persist(); } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
}

export async function listProjects() {
  const d = await db();
  const all = await asPromise(d.transaction("projects").objectStore("projects").getAll());
  return all.sort((a, b) => (b.created || 0) - (a.created || 0));
}

export async function saveProject(p) {
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("projects", "readwrite");
  tx.objectStore("projects").put(p);
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function loadPages(projectId) {
  const d = await db();
  const rows = await asPromise(d.transaction("pages").objectStore("pages").index("project_id").getAll(projectId));
  return rows.sort((a, b) => (a.order_index || 0) - (b.order_index || 0));
}

export async function savePages(pages) {
  if (!pages.length) return;
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("pages", "readwrite");
  const st = tx.objectStore("pages");
  pages.forEach((p) => { const { __content, ...rest } = p; st.put(rest); });
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function putContent(items) {
  if (!items.length) return;
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("content", "readwrite");
  const st = tx.objectStore("content");
  items.forEach((it) => st.put(it.html, it.id));
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function getContentMap(ids, onProgress) {
  const d = await db();
  const map = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 50) {
    const slice = ids.slice(i, i + 50);
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = d.transaction("content");
      const st = tx.objectStore("content");
      slice.forEach((id) => { const r = st.get(id); r.onsuccess = () => { if (r.result) map[id] = r.result; }; });
      tx.oncomplete = resolve;
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
    onProgress?.(Math.min(i + 50, ids.length), ids.length);
  }
  return map;
}

export async function deleteProject(projectId) {
  const d = await db();
  const pages = await loadPages(projectId);
  const tx = d.transaction(["projects", "pages", "content"], "readwrite");
  pages.forEach((p) => { tx.objectStore("pages").delete(p.id); tx.objectStore("content").delete(p.id); });
  tx.objectStore("projects").delete(projectId);
  await wait(tx);
}

#### FILE: src/crawler.js ####
/* Two phases, both on the phone:
   1) runDiscovery  – walks the WHOLE site (sitemap + internal links) and only counts/collects addresses
   2) runExtraction – downloads and extracts the text of the first N pages (N = ceiling chosen by the user) */
import { fetchHtml } from "./net.js";
import { collectSitemapUrls, extractLinks, isCrawlable, normalizeUrl, bareHost, pathOf, sectionOf, readSiteName } from "./site.js";
import { extractPage } from "./extract.js";
import * as store from "./store.js";

export const HARD_LIMIT = 500000; // most pages one project can hold
const SCAN_BATCH = 12;
const EXTRACT_BATCH = 8;

async function load(project) {
  const pages = await store.loadPages(project.id);
  const known = new Set(pages.map((p) => p.url));
  const host = bareHost(project.site_url);
  const st = { nextN: project.next_n || pages.length, dirty: [] };

  const addPage = (url, parsed) => {
    if (known.has(url) || pages.length >= HARD_LIMIT || !isCrawlable(url, host)) return null;
    known.add(url);
    const p = {
      id: `${project.id}|${st.nextN}`, project_id: project.id, url,
      path: pathOf(url), section: sectionOf(url), order_index: st.nextN,
      status: "pending", links_parsed: !!parsed, chunk_count: 0, word_count: 0, image_count: 0,
    };
    st.nextN += 1;
    pages.push(p);
    st.dirty.push(p);
    return p;
  };

  const flush = async () => {
    project.next_n = st.nextN;
    project.discovered = pages.length;
    project.updated = Date.now();
    const out = st.dirty; st.dirty = [];
    await store.savePages(out);
    await store.saveProject(project);
  };
  return { pages, host, st, addPage, flush };
}

/* ---------------- phase 1: walk the whole site and count it ---------------- */
export async function runDiscovery(project, { onProgress, shouldStop }) {
  await store.requestPersistence();
  const { pages, host, st, addPage, flush } = await load(project);
  project.status = "discovering";

  if (!project.seeded) {
    const root = normalizeUrl(project.site_url, project.site_url);
    if (root) addPage(root, false);
    try {
      const sm = await collectSitemapUrls(project.site_url, HARD_LIMIT);
      if (sm.urls.length) {
        project.sitemap_found = true;
        project.sitemap_url = sm.sitemapUrl;
        sm.urls.forEach((u) => addPage(u, true)); // the sitemap already lists them: no need to scan
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* no sitemap: internal links are followed instead */ }
    project.seeded = true;
    await flush();
    onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned: 0 });
  }

  const scanOne = async (page) => {
    try {
      const { html, finalUrl } = await fetchHtml(page.url, 25000);
      return { page, links: extractLinks(html, finalUrl || page.url, host), html };
    } catch (_e) {
      return { page, links: [], html: "" };
    }
  };

  let idx = pages.findIndex((p) => !p.links_parsed);
  if (idx < 0) idx = pages.length;
  let scanned = project.scanned || 0;
  let capped = pages.length >= HARD_LIMIT;

  while (!shouldStop() && !capped) {
    while (idx < pages.length && pages[idx].links_parsed) idx += 1;
    if (idx >= pages.length) break;
    const batch = [];
    for (let j = idx; j < pages.length && batch.length < SCAN_BATCH; j++) if (!pages[j].links_parsed) batch.push(pages[j]);

    const results = [];
    let cur = 0;
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(6, batch.length) }, async () => {
      while (cur < batch.length) results.push(await scanOne(batch[cur++]));
    }));

    for (const r of results) {
      r.page.links_parsed = true;
      st.dirty.push(r.page);
      r.links.forEach((l) => addPage(l, false));
      if (!project.site_name && r.html && r.page.order_index === 0) project.site_name = readSiteName(r.html);
    }
    scanned += batch.length;
    project.scanned = scanned;
    capped = pages.length >= HARD_LIMIT;
    await flush();
    onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned });
  }

  const finished = capped || !pages.some((p) => !p.links_parsed);
  if (finished) {
    project.discovery_done = true;
    project.capped = capped;
    project.status = "discovered";
    if (!project.site_name) project.site_name = project.domain;
  } else {
    project.status = "paused";
  }
  await flush();
  onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned, done: finished });
  return project;
}

/* ---------------- phase 2: download + extract the first N pages ---------------- */
export async function runExtraction(project, { onProgress, shouldStop, retryFailed = false }) {
  await store.requestPersistence();
  const { pages, st, flush } = await load(project);
  const target = Math.min(Number(project.max_pages) || 0, pages.length);
  const active = pages.slice(0, target);

  if (retryFailed) {
    active.forEach((p) => { if (p.status === "failed") { p.status = "pending"; p.error = ""; st.dirty.push(p); } });
  }
  let extracted = 0, failed = 0;
  active.forEach((p) => { if (p.status === "extracted") extracted += 1; else if (p.status === "failed") failed += 1; });

  project.status = "extracting";
  const report = () => onProgress?.({ phase: "extract", discovered: pages.length, target, extracted, failed });
  const sync = async () => { project.extracted = extracted; project.failed = failed; await flush(); report(); };
  await sync();

  const extractOne = async (page) => {
    try {
      const { html, finalUrl } = await fetchHtml(page.url, 25000);
      return { page, ok: true, data: extractPage(html, finalUrl || page.url) };
    } catch (e) {
      return { page, ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e).slice(0, 180) };
    }
  };

  let ptr = 0;
  while (!shouldStop()) {
    while (ptr < active.length && active[ptr].status !== "pending") ptr += 1;
    if (ptr >= active.length) break;
    const batch = [];
    for (let j = ptr; j < active.length && batch.length < EXTRACT_BATCH; j++) if (active[j].status === "pending") batch.push(active[j]);

    const results = [];
    let cur = 0;
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(4, batch.length) }, async () => {
      while (cur < batch.length) results.push(await extractOne(batch[cur++]));
    }));

    const contentRows = [];
    for (const r of results) {
      const p = r.page;
      st.dirty.push(p);
      if (!r.ok) { p.status = "failed"; p.error = r.error; failed += 1; continue; }
      const { content_html, outbound_links, text_preview, updated_date, ...meta } = r.data;
      Object.assign(p, meta, { modified_date: updated_date || "", status: "extracted", error: "", chunk_count: content_html ? 1 : 0 });
      if (content_html) contentRows.push({ id: p.id, html: content_html });
      extracted += 1;
    }
    try {
      await store.putContent(contentRows);
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error("ذخیرهٔ متن روی گوشی ناموفق بود (شاید حافظه پر است): " + String((e && e.message) || e));
    }
    await sync();
  }

  const left = active.some((p) => p.status === "pending");
  project.status = left ? "paused" : "ready";
  if (!left) project.finished = Date.now();
  await sync();
  return project;
}

#### FILE: src/documentBuilder.js ####
/* Builds clean, Word-friendly and printable archive documents, split into parts
   so that very large sites do not blow past the read-traffic or memory limits.
   The body is rendered from the extracted HTML into a small set of block-level
   tags with fully-escaped text, so no raw tag (such as <strong>) ever leaks into
   the final file — the reader sees exactly the text a normal visitor sees. */

import { faNum, formatFaDate, faLongDate } from "./format.js";

function esc(s) {
  return String(s == null ? "" : s)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}

function prettySection(key) {
  if (!key) return "صفحه اصلی";
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(key).replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").trim();
  } catch (e) {
    return key;
  }
}

export function documentSlug(project) {
  const base = String(project?.site_name || project?.domain || "site")
    .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .slice(0, 60)
    .trim();
  return base || "site-archive";
}

export function groupSections(pages) {
  const map = new Map();
  pages.forEach((p) => {
    const key = p.section || "";
    if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, { key, pages: [] });
    map.get(key).pages.push(p);
  });
  const sections = Array.from(map.values());
  sections.forEach((s) => {
    s.pages.sort((a, b) => (a.order_index ?? 0) - (b.order_index ?? 0));
    const withCat = s.pages.find((p) => p.category && p.category.trim());
    const label = withCat ? withCat.category.trim() : prettySection(s.key);
    s.label = label && label !== s.key ? label : prettySection(s.key);
    s.order = Math.min(...s.pages.map((p) => (typeof p.order_index === "number" ? p.order_index : 999999)));
  });
  sections.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
  return sections;
}

/* assign a global article number to every page, in site order */
export function numberSections(sections) {
  let n = 0;
  sections.forEach((s) => s.pages.forEach((p) => { n += 1; p.globalNumber = n; }));
}

/* pack pages into parts that each stay under a page budget. A very large section
   is split across parts too, so even a single-section site is delivered in pieces. */
export function partitionSections(sections, maxPagesPerPart = 200) {
  const parts = [];
  let cur = null;
  const pushGroup = (label, pages) => {
    if (!cur || cur.pageCount + pages.length > maxPagesPerPart) {
      cur = { groups: [], pageCount: 0 };
      parts.push(cur);
    }
    cur.groups.push({ label, pages });
    cur.pageCount += pages.length;
  };
  sections.forEach((s) => {
    if (s.pages.length <= maxPagesPerPart) {
      pushGroup(s.label, s.pages);
    } else {
      let n = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < s.pages.length; i += maxPagesPerPart) {
        n += 1;
        const slice = s.pages.slice(i, i + maxPagesPerPart);
        pushGroup(`${s.label} (${faNum(n)})`, slice);
      }
    }
  });
  return parts;
}

function imagePolicy(mode) {
  if (mode === "text") return { inline: false, cap: 0, featured: false };
  if (mode === "featured") return { inline: false, cap: 0, featured: true };
  if (mode === "auto") return { inline: true, cap: 8, featured: false };
  return { inline: true, cap: Infinity, featured: false }; /* "all" */
}

function renderTable(table, inlineText) {
  const rows = [];
  table.querySelectorAll("tr").forEach((tr) => {
    const cells = [];
    tr.querySelectorAll("td,th").forEach((c) => {
      const t = inlineText(c).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      cells.push(`<${c.tagName.toLowerCase()}>${esc(t)}</${c.tagName.toLowerCase()}>`);
    });
    if (cells.length) rows.push(`<tr>${cells.join("")}</tr>`);
  });
  return rows.length ? `<table>${rows.join("")}</table>` : "";
}

/* render the extracted content as clean block-level HTML: headings, paragraphs,
   lists, blockquotes, tables and images. inline tags (strong/em/a) are flattened
   to their text so the reader sees plain readable text — never tag soup. */
function renderArticleBody(contentHtml, { imageMode, page }) {
  if (!contentHtml || !contentHtml.trim()) return "";
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(`<div id="__r">${contentHtml}</div>`, "text/html");
  const root = doc.getElementById("__r");
  if (!root) return "";

  const policy = imagePolicy(imageMode);
  const imageSet = new Set((page.images || []).map((i) => i.url));
  let imgCount = 0;

  const inlineText = (node) => {
    let s = "";
    node.childNodes.forEach((c) => {
      if (c.nodeType === 3) s += c.textContent || "";
      else if (c.nodeType === 1) {
        if (c.tagName === "BR") s += "\n";
        else s += inlineText(c);
      }
    });
    return s;
  };

  const out = [];
  function walk(node) {
    node.childNodes.forEach((child) => {
      if (child.nodeType === 3) {
        const t = (child.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
        if (t.trim()) out.push(`<p>${esc(t)}</p>`);
        return;
      }
      if (child.nodeType !== 1) return;
      const tag = child.tagName;

      if (tag === "IMG") {
        if (policy.inline && imgCount < policy.cap) {
          const src = child.getAttribute("src") || "";
          if (src && (!imageSet.size || imageSet.has(src))) {
            out.push(`<img src="${esc(src)}" alt="${esc(child.getAttribute("alt") || "")}"/>`);
            imgCount += 1;
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      if (tag === "FIGURE" || tag === "PICTURE") { walk(child); return; }
      if (tag === "BR") { out.push("<br/>"); return; }
      if (tag === "UL" || tag === "OL") {
        const items = [];
        child.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach((li) => {
          const t = inlineText(li).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
          if (t) items.push(`<li>${esc(t)}</li>`);
        });
        if (items.length) out.push(`<${tag.toLowerCase()}>${items.join("")}</${tag.toLowerCase()}>`);
        return;
      }
      if (tag === "TABLE") { const t = renderTable(child, inlineText); if (t) out.push(t); return; }
      if (/^H[1-6]$/.test(tag)) {
        const t = inlineText(child).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (t) out.push(`<${tag.toLowerCase()}>${esc(t)}</${tag.toLowerCase()}>`);
        return;
      }
      if (tag === "P" || tag === "BLOCKQUOTE" || tag === "PRE") {
        const t = inlineText(child).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (t) out.push(`<${tag.toLowerCase()}>${esc(t)}</${tag.toLowerCase()}>`);
        return;
      }
      walk(child);
    });
  }
  walk(root);

  let body = out.join("").replace(/<(p|li|ul|ol|blockquote|h[1-6]|td|th|table)>/g, '<$1 dir="auto">');
  if (policy.featured) {
    const fi = (page.images || [])[0];
    if (fi && fi.url) {
      body = `<img class="featured" src="${esc(fi.url)}" alt="${esc(fi.alt || page.title || "")}"/>` + body;
    }
  }
  return body;
}

function articleHtml(page, number, imageMode) {
  const meta = [];
  if (page.published_date) meta.push("تاریخ انتشار: " + formatFaDate(page.published_date));
  if (page.author) meta.push("نویسنده: " + esc(page.author));
  if (page.category) meta.push("دسته: " + esc(page.category));
  meta.push("کلمات: " + faNum(page.word_count || 0));

  const body = renderArticleBody(page.__content || "", { imageMode, page });
  const empty = !body.trim();
  const emptyNote = page.status === "failed"
    ? "استخراج این صفحه ناموفق بود" + (page.error ? ": " + esc(page.error) : "")
    : "این صفحه متن قابل‌استخراجی نداشت";

  return (
    `<article class="art">` +
    `<h2 dir="auto"><span class="num">${faNum(number)}</span> ${esc(page.title || page.path || page.url)}</h2>` +
    `<p class="url"><a href="${esc(page.url)}">${esc(page.url)}</a></p>` +
    (meta.length ? `<p class="meta">${meta.join(" • ")}</p>` : "") +
    (page.description ? `<p class="desc" dir="auto">${esc(page.description)}</p>` : "") +
    (empty ? `<p class="empty">${emptyNote}</p>` : body) +
    `</article>`
  );
}

function styles() {
  return (
    "body{font-family:'Vazirmatn','B Nazanin',Tahoma,sans-serif;direction:rtl;text-align:start;color:#12211f;line-height:1.95;font-size:11.5pt;margin:0;padding:28px 34px;background:#fff}" +
    "h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.6;color:#123f39}" +
    "p{margin:0 0 9pt}" +
    "a{color:#17625a;text-decoration:none}" +
    "img{max-width:480px;height:auto;border-radius:6px;margin:6px 0}" +
    "img.featured{max-width:360px}" +
    "blockquote{border-inline-start:3px solid #cbb894;padding:2px 12px;margin:10px 0;color:#3b4a47;background:#faf7f1}" +
    "table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin:10px 0}" +
    "td,th{border:1px solid #cfd6d4;padding:6px 8px;font-size:10.5pt}" +
    "ul,ol{margin:0 0 9pt;padding-inline-start:20px;padding-inline-end:0}" +
    "pre{background:#f4f6f6;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;direction:ltr;text-align:left;font-size:10pt;white-space:pre-wrap}" +
    ".cover{text-align:center;padding:50px 0 36px;border-bottom:2px solid #dcd3c2}" +
    ".cover h1{font-size:28pt;margin:0 0 8px}" +
    ".cover .src{font-size:11pt;color:#4d5c59;direction:ltr}" +
    ".cover .sub{color:#5d6b68;font-size:12pt;margin:2px 0}" +
    ".cover .fx{color:#17625a;font-weight:700}" +
    ".bism{font-size:22pt;color:#123f39;margin:0 0 4px}" +
    ".bism2{font-size:15pt;color:#4d5c59;margin:0 0 30px}" +
    ".toc{margin-top:26px;text-align:right}" +
    ".toc h2{font-size:16pt;border-bottom:1px solid #dcd3c2;padding-bottom:6px}" +
    ".toc ol{padding-right:22px}" +
    ".toc li{margin:4px 0;font-size:11pt}" +
    ".chapter{page-break-before:always;font-size:21pt;color:#123f39;border-bottom:2px solid #123f39;padding-bottom:8px;margin:0 0 18px}" +
    ".chapter small{display:block;font-size:10.5pt;color:#5d6b68;font-weight:400;margin-top:6px}" +
    ".art{margin:0 0 28px}" +
    ".art p,.art li,.art blockquote{text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-word}" +
    ".art h2{font-size:15pt;margin:22px 0 6px;page-break-after:avoid}" +
    ".art .num{display:inline-block;background:#123f39;color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:1px 10px;font-size:11pt;margin-left:6px}" +
    ".art .url{font-size:9.5pt;color:#7b8785;direction:ltr;text-align:left;word-break:break-all;margin:0 0 4px}" +
    ".art .meta{font-size:9.5pt;color:#5d6b68;margin:0 0 8px}" +
    ".art .desc{background:#f7f4ee;border-right:3px solid #cbb894;padding:8px 12px;font-size:11pt;color:#3b4a47}" +
    ".empty{color:#8a9492;font-style:italic;font-size:10.5pt}" +
    "@page{size:A4;margin:16mm 14mm}" +
    "figure,img,blockquote,pre,table{page-break-inside:avoid}"
  );
}

function wrapHtml(title, bodyInner) {
  return (
    `<!DOCTYPE html>` +
    `<html xmlns:o="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office" xmlns:w="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-html40" lang="fa" dir="rtl">` +
    `<head><meta charset="utf-8"/>` +
    `<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8"/>` +
    `<meta name="ProgId" content="Word.Document"/>` +
    `<title>${esc(title)}</title>` +
    `<style>${styles()}</style></head>` +
    `<body>${bodyInner}</body></html>`
  );
}

export function buildPartHtml({ project, parts, partIndex, imageMode }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const partCount = parts.length;
  const siteName = project.site_name || project.domain || project.site_url;
  const generated = new Date().toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });

  const chapters = part.groups
    .map((g) => {
      const head = `<h1 class="chapter">${esc(g.label)}<small>${faNum(g.pages.length)} صفحه در این بخش</small></h1>`;
      const body = g.pages.map((p) => articleHtml(p, p.globalNumber, imageMode)).join("");
      return head + body;
    })
    .join("");

  const downloaded = faLongDate(project.finished || project.created);
  const totalPages = parts.reduce((n, pp) => n + pp.pageCount, 0);
  let toc = "";
  if (partIndex === 0 && partCount > 1) {
    const items = parts
      .map((pp, i) => {
        const nums = pp.groups.flatMap((g) => g.pages).map((p) => p.globalNumber);
        const min = nums.length ? Math.min(...nums) : 0;
        const max = nums.length ? Math.max(...nums) : 0;
        return `<li>بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} — مقاله\u200cهای ${faNum(min)} تا ${faNum(max)} (${faNum(pp.pageCount)} صفحه)</li>`;
      })
      .join("");
    toc = `<div class="toc"><h2>فهرست بخش\u200cها</h2><ol>${items}</ol></div>`;
  }
  const cover =
    `<section class="cover">` +
    `<p class="bism">بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم</p>` +
    `<p class="bism2">الله مولانا و لا مولا لکم</p>` +
    `<h1>${esc(siteName)}</h1>` +
    `<p class="src">${esc(project.site_url)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub">تاریخ دانلود: ${esc(downloaded)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub">تعداد صفحات: ${faNum(totalPages)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub fx">تهیه شده توسط اپ فراکسینتوم</p>` +
    (partCount > 1 ? `<p class="sub">بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(partCount)}</p>` : "") +
    toc +
    `</section>`;

  return wrapHtml(siteName, cover + chapters);
}

export function buildSitemapXml(project, pages) {
  const rows = pages
    .map((p) => {
      const last = (p.published_date || "").slice(0, 10);
      return (
        "  <url>\n    <loc>" + esc(p.url) + "</loc>" +
        (last ? "\n    <lastmod>" + esc(last) + "</lastmod>" : "") +
        "\n    <priority>0.7</priority>\n  </url>"
      );
    })
    .join("\n");
  return (
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n' +
    '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n' +
    "  <!-- " + esc(project.site_url) + " — ساخته‌شده در " + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + " -->\n" +
    "  <!-- " + pages.length + " URLs -->\n" +
    rows +
    "\n</urlset>\n"
  );
}

function csvCell(v) {
  const s = String(v == null ? "" : v);
  return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
}

export function buildPagesCsv(pages) {
  const header = ["ردیف", "عنوان", "نشانی", "بخش", "دسته", "تاریخ انتشار", "نویسنده", "کلمات", "تعداد تصاویر", "وضعیت"];
  const rows = pages.map((p, i) => [
    i + 1,
    p.title || "",
    p.url,
    p.section || "",
    p.category || "",
    p.published_date || "",
    p.author || "",
    p.word_count || 0,
    p.image_count || 0,
    p.status === "extracted" ? "استخراج شد" : p.status === "failed" ? "ناموفق" : "در انتظار",
  ]);
  return "\uFEFF" + [header, ...rows].map((r) => r.map(csvCell).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
}

export function downloadFile(content, filename, mime) {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime + ";charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    a.remove();
  }, 3000);
}

#### FILE: src/docxBuilder.js ####
/* Real .docx (not HTML-in-disguise), built in the browser with the `docx` package.
   Persian/RTL: every paragraph is bidirectional and every run is right-to-left. */
import {
  Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, HeadingLevel, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  WidthType, ImageRun, ExternalHyperlink, AlignmentType,
} from "docx";
import { faNum, formatFaDate, faLongDate } from "./format.js";

const FONT = "Tahoma"; // ships with Windows/Office and covers Persian
const SIZE = 24; // half-points = 12pt

function run(text, o = {}) {
  return new TextRun({
    text: String(text == null ? "" : text),
    font: FONT,
    rightToLeft: o.ltr ? false : o.rtl !== false,
    size: o.size || SIZE,
    sizeComplexScript: true,
    bold: !!o.bold,
    boldComplexScript: !!o.bold,
    italics: !!o.italics,
    color: o.color,
    language: o.ltr || o.rtl === false ? { value: "en-US" } : { value: "fa-IR", bidirectional: "fa-IR" },
  });
}

function para(children, o = {}) {
  return new Paragraph({
    bidirectional: o.rtl !== false,
    spacing: { before: o.before ?? 0, after: o.after ?? 140, line: o.line ?? 360 },
    heading: o.heading,
    pageBreakBefore: !!o.pageBreakBefore,
    alignment: o.center ? AlignmentType.CENTER : o.justify ? AlignmentType.JUSTIFIED : undefined,
    indent: o.indent,
    keepNext: !!o.keepNext,
    children: Array.isArray(children) ? children : [children],
  });
}

const textPara = (t, o) => para(run(t, o), o);

/* direction follows the language of the text: Persian/Arabic -> right-to-left,
   English (and other Latin/Cyrillic/Greek) -> left-to-right */
const AR_RE = /[\u0590-\u08FF\uFB1D-\uFDFF\uFE70-\uFEFF]/g;
const LAT_RE = /[A-Za-z\u00C0-\u024F\u0370-\u03FF\u0400-\u04FF]/g;
function detectRtl(text, fallback = true) {
  const t = String(text || "");
  const a = (t.match(AR_RE) || []).length;
  const l = (t.match(LAT_RE) || []).length;
  if (!a && !l) return fallback;
  return a >= l;
}

function cleanText(node) {
  let s = "";
  node.childNodes.forEach((c) => {
    if (c.nodeType === 3) s += c.textContent || "";
    else if (c.nodeType === 1) s += c.tagName === "BR" ? "\n" : cleanText(c);
  });
  return s.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

/* ---------- images (best effort: needs the image host to allow CORS) ---------- */
async function loadImage(url) {
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 9000);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctl.signal, mode: "cors" });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    let blob = await res.blob();
    if (blob.size > 4_000_000 || blob.size < 200) return null;
    let type = (blob.type || "").toLowerCase();
    const bmp = await createImageBitmap(blob);
    let w = bmp.width;
    let h = bmp.height;
    if (!/image\/(png|jpe?g)/.test(type)) {
      // webp / gif / svg / bmp -> png through a canvas
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
      canvas.getContext("2d").drawImage(bmp, 0, 0);
      blob = await new Promise((r) => canvas.toBlob(r, "image/png"));
      type = "image/png";
      if (!blob) return null;
    }
    const data = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
    const maxW = 420;
    if (w > maxW) { h = Math.round((h * maxW) / w); w = maxW; }
    return { data, type: /png/.test(type) ? "png" : "jpg", width: w, height: h };
  } catch (_e) {
    return null;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

async function imageParagraph(src, alt, stats) {
  const img = await loadImage(src);
  if (!img) { stats.skipped += 1; return null; }
  stats.embedded += 1;
  return para(
    new ImageRun({ type: img.type, data: img.data, transformation: { width: img.width, height: img.height }, altText: { title: alt || "image", description: alt || "image", name: "image" } }),
    { center: true },
  );
}

/* ---------- article HTML -> docx blocks ---------- */
function tableBlock(tableEl, def) {
  const rows = [];
  let cols = 0;
  tableEl.querySelectorAll("tr").forEach((tr) => {
    const cells = [];
    tr.querySelectorAll("td,th").forEach((c) => cells.push({ t: cleanText(c), head: c.tagName === "TH" }));
    if (cells.length) { rows.push(cells); cols = Math.max(cols, cells.length); }
  });
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const tableRtl = detectRtl(rows.map((r) => r.map((c) => c.t).join(" ")).join(" "), def);
  const total = 9000;
  const w = Math.floor(total / cols);
  return new Table({
    width: { size: total, type: WidthType.DXA },
    columnWidths: Array(cols).fill(w),
    visuallyRightToLeft: tableRtl,
    rows: rows.map((cells) =>
      new TableRow({
        children: Array.from({ length: cols }, (_v, i) => {
          const c = cells[i] || { t: "", head: false };
          return new TableCell({
            width: { size: w, type: WidthType.DXA },
            children: [para(run(c.t, { size: 21, bold: c.head, rtl: tableRtl }), { after: 40, line: 300, rtl: tableRtl })],
          });
        }),
      }),
    ),
  });
}

async function bodyBlocks(contentHtml, page, imageMode, stats) {
  if (!contentHtml || !contentHtml.trim()) return [];
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(`<div id="__r">${contentHtml}</div>`, "text/html");
  const root = doc.getElementById("__r");
  if (!root) return [];
  const def = detectRtl(cleanText(root), true);

  const allowImg = imageMode === "auto" || imageMode === "all";
  const cap = imageMode === "auto" ? 8 : Infinity;
  const known = new Set((page.images || []).map((i) => i.url));
  let imgCount = 0;
  const out = [];

  const walk = async (node) => {
    for (const child of Array.from(node.childNodes)) {
      if (child.nodeType === 3) {
        const t = (child.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (t) out.push(textPara(t, { justify: true, rtl: detectRtl(t, def) }));
        continue;
      }
      if (child.nodeType !== 1) continue;
      const tag = child.tagName;
      if (tag === "IMG") {
        if (allowImg && imgCount < cap) {
          const src = child.getAttribute("src") || "";
          if (src && (!known.size || known.has(src))) {
            imgCount += 1;
            const p = await imageParagraph(src, child.getAttribute("alt"), stats);
            if (p) out.push(p);
          }
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (tag === "FIGURE" || tag === "PICTURE") { await walk(child); continue; }
      if (tag === "UL" || tag === "OL") {
        let n = 0;
        child.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach((li) => {
          const t = cleanText(li);
          if (!t) return;
          n += 1;
          const mark = tag === "OL" ? `${faNum(n)}. ` : "• ";
          const r = detectRtl(t, def);
          out.push(para(run(mark + t, { rtl: r }), { indent: { start: 360 }, after: 80, justify: true, rtl: r }));
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (tag === "TABLE") { const t = tableBlock(child, def); if (t) out.push(t); continue; }
      if (/^H[1-6]$/.test(tag)) {
        const t = cleanText(child);
        if (t) { const r = detectRtl(t, def); out.push(para(run(t, { bold: true, size: 26, color: "123F39", rtl: r }), { keepNext: true, after: 100, rtl: r })); }
        continue;
      }
      if (tag === "BLOCKQUOTE") {
        const t = cleanText(child);
        if (t) { const r = detectRtl(t, def); out.push(para(run(t, { italics: true, color: "3B4A47", rtl: r }), { indent: { start: 480 }, justify: true, rtl: r })); }
        continue;
      }
      if (tag === "P" || tag === "PRE") {
        const t = cleanText(child);
        if (t) out.push(textPara(t, { justify: true, rtl: detectRtl(t, def) }));
        continue;
      }
      await walk(child);
    }
  };
  await walk(root);
  return out;
}

async function articleBlocks(page, number, imageMode, stats) {
  const title = page.title || page.path || page.url;
  const pageRtl = detectRtl((page.__content || "").replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " "), true);
  const titleRtl = detectRtl(title, pageRtl);
  const blocks = [
    para(run(`${faNum(number)}. ${title}`, { bold: true, size: 32, color: "123F39", rtl: titleRtl }), { heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, keepNext: true, after: 80, rtl: titleRtl }),
    para(
      new ExternalHyperlink({
        link: page.url,
        children: [new TextRun({ text: page.url, font: FONT, size: 18, color: "17625A", style: "Hyperlink" })],
      }),
      { after: 60, line: 260 },
    ),
  ];
  const meta = [];
  if (page.published_date) meta.push("تاریخ انتشار: " + formatFaDate(page.published_date));
  if (page.author) meta.push("نویسنده: " + page.author);
  if (page.category) meta.push("دسته: " + page.category);
  meta.push("کلمات: " + faNum(page.word_count || 0));
  blocks.push(para(run(meta.join("  •  "), { size: 19, color: "5D6B68" }), { after: 100 }));
  if (page.description) { const dr = detectRtl(page.description, pageRtl); blocks.push(para(run(page.description, { color: "3B4A47", italics: true, rtl: dr }), { indent: { start: 240 }, rtl: dr })); }

  const body = await bodyBlocks(page.__content || "", page, imageMode, stats);
  if (body.length) blocks.push(...body);
  else {
    const note = page.status === "failed"
      ? "استخراج این صفحه ناموفق بود" + (page.error ? ": " + page.error : "")
      : "این صفحه متن قابل‌استخراجی نداشت";
    blocks.push(para(run(note, { italics: true, color: "8A9492", size: 21 })));
  }
  return blocks;
}

/* ---------- whole part -> Blob ---------- */
export async function buildDocxBlob({ project, parts, partIndex, imageMode, onProgress }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const siteName = project.site_name || project.domain || project.site_url;
  const downloaded = faLongDate(project.finished || project.created);
  const totalPages = parts.reduce((n, pp) => n + pp.pageCount, 0);
  const stats = { embedded: 0, skipped: 0 };

  const children = [
    para(run("بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم", { bold: true, size: 44, color: "123F39" }), { center: true, before: 500, after: 60 }),
    para(run("الله مولانا و لا مولا لکم", { size: 30, color: "4D5C59" }), { center: true, after: 520 }),
    para(run(siteName, { bold: true, size: 56, color: "123F39", rtl: detectRtl(siteName, true) }), { center: true, after: 160, rtl: detectRtl(siteName, true) }),
    para(run(project.site_url, { ltr: true, size: 22, color: "4D5C59" }), { center: true }),
    para(run("تاریخ دانلود: " + downloaded, { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
    para(run("تعداد صفحات: " + faNum(totalPages), { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
    para(run("تهیه شده توسط اپ فراکسینتوم", { bold: true, size: 26, color: "17625A" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
  ];
  if (parts.length > 1) {
    children.push(para(run(`بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(parts.length)}`, { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true }));
  }

  if (partIndex === 0 && parts.length > 1) {
    children.push(para(run("فهرست بخش‌ها", { bold: true, size: 30 }), { heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, after: 100 }));
    parts.forEach((pp, i) => {
      const nums = pp.groups.flatMap((g) => g.pages).map((p) => p.globalNumber);
      const lo = nums.length ? Math.min(...nums) : 0;
      const hi = nums.length ? Math.max(...nums) : 0;
      children.push(textPara(`بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} — مقاله‌های ${faNum(lo)} تا ${faNum(hi)} (${faNum(pp.pageCount)} صفحه)`, { after: 60 }));
    });
  }

  const total = part.groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.pages.length, 0);
  let done = 0;
  for (const g of part.groups) {
    children.push(
      para(run(g.label, { bold: true, size: 44, color: "123F39", rtl: detectRtl(g.label, true) }), { heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, pageBreakBefore: true, after: 60, rtl: detectRtl(g.label, true) }),
      para(run(`${faNum(g.pages.length)} صفحه در این بخش`, { size: 21, color: "5D6B68" })),
    );
    for (const p of g.pages) {
      children.push(...(await articleBlocks(p, p.globalNumber, imageMode, stats)));
      done += 1;
      if (done % 5 === 0) {
        onProgress?.(done, total);
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); // let the UI breathe on phones
      }
    }
  }
  onProgress?.(total, total);

  const doc = new Document({
    creator: "آرشیوساز",
    title: siteName,
    styles: { default: { document: { run: { font: FONT, size: SIZE } } } },
    sections: [{
      properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 1134, bottom: 1134, left: 1134, right: 1134 } } },
      children,
    }],
  });
  const blob = await Packer.toBlob(doc);
  return { blob, stats };
}

export function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 5000);
}

import { Capacitor, registerPlugin } from "@capacitor/core";
import { Filesystem, Directory } from "@capacitor/filesystem";
import { Share } from "@capacitor/share";

const PrintHtml = registerPlugin("PrintHtml");

function blobToBase64(blob) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => resolve(String(r.result).split(",")[1] || "");
    r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
    r.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

/* Android: write to the app cache, then open the system share sheet
   (save to Files / Drive / send to any app). Browser: normal download. */
export async function saveAndShare(blob, filename) {
  if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
    const data = await blobToBase64(blob);
    await Filesystem.writeFile({ path: filename, data, directory: Directory.Cache });
    const { uri } = await Filesystem.getUri({ path: filename, directory: Directory.Cache });
    await Share.share({ title: filename, url: uri, dialogTitle: "ذخیره یا ارسال فایل" });
    return;
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 4000);
}

export async function saveText(text, filename, mime) {
  return saveAndShare(new Blob([text], { type: mime + ";charset=utf-8" }), filename);
}

/* PDF: written directly by Android (no print dialog). Android 10+ saves it to
   Download/FRAXINETUM; older versions open the share sheet instead. */
export async function saveHtmlAsPdf(html, filename) {
  if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
    const r = await PrintHtml.toPdf({ html, filename });
    if (r.saved) return { where: r.location };
    await Share.share({ title: filename, url: "file://" + r.path, dialogTitle: "ذخیره یا ارسال PDF" });
    return { where: "" };
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" }));
  window.open(url, "_blank");
  return { where: "" };
}

/* In-app update check. Every build is numbered with the GitHub run number; the app
   asks GitHub for the newest successful build of this repo and, if it is newer,
   opens the direct APK link (Android installs it over the old version and keeps
   all saved data, because every build is signed with the same key). */
import { Browser } from "@capacitor/browser";

export const BUILD = typeof __BUILD__ !== "undefined" ? __BUILD__ : 0;
export const REPO = typeof __REPO__ !== "undefined" ? __REPO__ : "";

export function apkUrl() {
  return `https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/FRAXINETUM.apk`;
}

export async function checkUpdate() {
  if (!REPO) return { ok: false, error: "نسخهٔ آزمایشی؛ آدرس مخزن مشخص نیست." };
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/actions/runs?status=success&per_page=1`, {
      headers: { Accept: "application/vnd.github+json" },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: "پاسخ GitHub: " + res.status + " (مخزن باید عمومی باشد)" };
    const j = await res.json();
    const latest = Number(j.workflow_runs?.[0]?.run_number || 0);
    return { ok: true, latest, available: latest > BUILD };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: "بررسی انجام نشد: " + String((e && e.message) || e) };
  }
}

export async function downloadUpdate() {
  await Browser.open({ url: apkUrl() });
}

function progressHtml() {
  const p = S.progress || {};
  const pr = S.project;

    return `<div class="stats" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"><div><b>${faNum(disc)}</b><span>صفحهٔ یافت‌شده</span></div><div><b>${faNum(scanned)}</b><span>صفحهٔ بررسی‌شده</span></div></div>`;
  }
  const disc = p.discovered ?? pr.discovered ?? 0;
  const target = p.target ?? Math.min(pr.max_pages || 0, disc);
  const ex = p.extracted ?? pr.extracted ?? 0;
  const fl = p.failed ?? pr.failed ?? 0;
  const pct = target ? Math.min(100, Math.round(((ex + fl) / target) * 100)) : 0;
  return `<div class="bar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
    <div class="stats"><div><b>${faNum(disc)}</b><span>کل سایت</span></div><div><b>${faNum(ex)}</b><span>استخراج</span></div><div><b>${faNum(fl)}</b><span>ناموفق</span></div><div><b>${faNum(Math.max(0, target - ex - fl))}</b><span>باقی‌مانده</span></div></div>`;
}

function setStatus(t) {

}

async function refreshProjects() {
  S.projects = await store.listProjects();
}

async function openProject(id) {
  S.project = (await store.listProjects()).find((p) => p.id === id);
  S.view = "project"; S.parts = null; S.pages = null; S.msg = ""; S.error = ""; S.progress = null; S.status = "";
  render();
}

async function newProject() {
  let raw = document.getElementById("url").value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById("msg");
  if (!raw) return;
  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) raw = "https://" + raw;
  let host = "";
  try { host = bareHost(raw); new URL(raw); } catch (_e) { if (msg) msg.innerHTML = `<div class="note err">نشانی معتبر نیست.</div>`; return; }
  const project = {
    id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
    site_url: raw, domain: host, site_name: "", max_pages: 0,
    status: "discovering", created: Date.now(), discovered: 0, extracted: 0, failed: 0,
    seeded: false, discovery_done: false, next_n: 0,
  };
  await store.saveProject(project);
  await openProject(project.id);
  runPhase("discover");
}

async function runPhase(kind, retry = false) {
  if (S.running) return;
  S.running = true; S.stop = false; S.error = ""; render();
  const opts = { shouldStop: () => S.stop, onProgress: (p) => { S.progress = p; updateProgress(); } };
  try {
    if (kind === "discover") await runDiscovery(S.project, opts);
    else await runExtraction(S.project, { ...opts, retryFailed: retry });
  } catch (e) {
    S.error = String((e && e.message) || e);
    S.project.status = "paused";
    await store.saveProject(S.project);
  }
  S.running = false; S.parts = null; S.progress = null; render();
}

async function chooseCeilingAndExtract() {
  const v = document.getElementById("ceil").value;
  S.project.max_pages = v === "all" ? S.project.discovered : Number(v);
  S.project.status = "extracting";
  await store.saveProject(S.project);
  runPhase("extract");
}

async function prepare() {
  S.busy = "prepare"; setStatus("در حال بارگذاری فهرست…");
  try {
    const all = await store.loadPages(S.project.id);
    S.pages = all.filter((p) => p.order_index < (S.project.max_pages || 0));
    const sections = groupSections(S.pages);
    numberSections(sections);
    S.parts = partitionSections(sections, perPart(S.imageMode));
    S.msg = S.parts.length > 1 ? `خروجی در ${faNum(S.parts.length)} بخش آماده شد؛ هر بخش را جدا بسازید.` : "خروجی آماده است.";
  } catch (e) { S.msg = String(e.message || e); }
  S.busy = ""; S.status = ""; render();
}

async function loadPart(i) {
  const pages = S.parts[i].groups.flatMap((g) => g.pages);
  const ids = pages.filter((p) => (p.chunk_count || 0) > 0).map((p) => p.id);
  const map = await store.getContentMap(ids, (n, t) => setStatus(`بارگذاری متن: ${faNum(n)} از ${faNum(t)}`));
  pages.forEach((p) => { p.__content = map[p.id] || ""; });
  return pages;
}

async function exportPart(i, kind) {
  S.busy = kind; S.msg = ""; render();
  try {
    const pages = await loadPart(i);
    const slug = documentSlug(S.project);
    const suffix = S.parts.length > 1 ? `-part-${i + 1}` : "";
    if (kind === "word") {
      setStatus("در حال ساخت فایل Word…");
      const { blob, stats } = await buildDocxBlob({
        project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i, imageMode: S.imageMode,
        onProgress: (n, t) => setStatus(`ساخت Word: ${faNum(n)} از ${faNum(t)}`),
      });
      await saveAndShare(blob, `${slug}${suffix}.docx`);
      S.msg = `بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} (${faNum(pages.length)} صفحه) ساخته شد.` +
        (S.imageMode !== "text" ? ` تصاویر: ${faNum(stats.embedded)} جاسازی شد، ${faNum(stats.skipped)} نشد.` : "");
    } else {
      setStatus("در حال ساخت PDF… (برای بخش‌های بزرگ چند دقیقه طول می‌کشد)");
      const html = buildPartHtml({ project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i, imageMode: S.imageMode });
      const r = await saveHtmlAsPdf(html, `${slug}${suffix}.pdf`);
      S.msg = r.where
        ? `PDF بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} ذخیره شد: پوشهٔ ${r.where}`
        : `PDF بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} ساخته شد.`;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    S.msg = "ساخت فایل ناموفق بود: " + String((e && e.message) || e);
  }
  S.busy = ""; S.status = ""; render();
}

async function exportSimple(kind) {
  try {
    const pages = await store.loadPages(S.project.id);
    const slug = documentSlug(S.project);
    if (kind === "csv") await saveText(buildPagesCsv(pages), `${slug}-links.csv`, "text/csv");
    else await saveText(buildSitemapXml(S.project, pages), `${slug}-sitemap.xml`, "application/xml");
  } catch (e) { S.msg = String((e && e.message) || e); render(); }
}

app.addEventListener("click", async (ev) => {
  const b = ev.target.closest("[data-act]");
  if (!b) return;
  const act = b.dataset.act;
  if (act === "new") return newProject();
  if (act === "open") return openProject(b.dataset.id);
  if (act === "del") {
    if (!confirm("این پروژه و همهٔ متن‌های آن از گوشی پاک شود؟")) return;
    await store.deleteProject(b.dataset.id); await refreshProjects(); return render();
  }
  if (act === "back") { await refreshProjects(); S.view = "home"; return render(); }
  if (act === "rename") {
    const n = prompt("نام سایت (روی جلد فایل چاپ می‌شود):", S.project.site_name || S.project.domain);
    if (n && n.trim()) { S.project.site_name = n.trim(); await store.saveProject(S.project); render(); }
    return;
  }
  if (act === "checkupd") {
    S.update = null; const el = document.getElementById("upd"); if (el) el.innerHTML = `<div class="note">در حال بررسی…</div>`;
    S.update = await checkUpdate(); if (el) el.innerHTML = updateHtml(); return;
  }
  if (act === "doupd") return downloadUpdate();
  if (act === "discover") return runPhase("discover");
  if (act === "extract") return chooseCeilingAndExtract();
  if (act === "extract-resume") return runPhase("extract");
  if (act === "retry") return runPhase("extract", true);
  if (act === "stop") { S.stop = true; return; }
  if (act === "prepare") return prepare();
  if (act === "word") return exportPart(Number(b.dataset.i), "word");
  if (act === "pdf") return exportPart(Number(b.dataset.i), "pdf");
  if (act === "xml" || act === "csv") return exportSimple(act);
});

app.addEventListener("change", (ev) => {
  if (ev.target.id === "imode") { S.imageMode = ev.target.value; S.parts = null; render(); }
});

(async () => {
  await refreshProjects();
  render();
  // silent update check on start (only shows a banner if a newer build exists)
  checkUpdate().then((u) => { if (u.ok && u.available) { S.update = u; const el = document.getElementById("upd"); if (el) el.innerHTML = updateHtml(); } });
})();
